claims.label: Romney–Netanyahu Friendship Dated to 1976 at Boston Consulting Group
claims.claim: A 2012 New York Times article confirms that the friendship between Mitt Romney and Benjamin Netanyahu dates to 1976 when both worked at the Boston Consulting Group.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the NYT 2012 article in full and verify the 1976 Boston Consulting Group employment dates against public records.

claims.label: Kash Patel Declared Subject in Custody ~4 Hours After Shooting
claims.claim: Kash Patel authored an X post at approximately 4:21 PM MST on 2025-09-10 stating that the subject in the Charlie Kirk shooting was in custody.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the tweet's exact timestamp and confirm the subject's identity against law enforcement records.

claims.label: Same Subject Released After Interrogation ~90 Minutes Later
claims.claim: At 5:59 PM the same day, Kash Patel posted that the previously detained subject had been released after interrogation by law enforcement, with no further explanation given.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain law enforcement records documenting the detention, interrogation, and release; cross-reference with identity of "Zachariah Karashy."

claims.label: Detained Subject Identified as Zachariah Karashy
claims.claim: The young man detained and released after interrogation is referred to as "Zachariah Karashy," with the host later connecting him to Ahmed Qureshi's son "Zachariah."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm spelling of "Karashy" vs. "Qureshi" against official detention records; the name discrepancy requires resolution.

claims.label: Ahmed Qureshi Is Active-Duty Navy Captain (O6)
claims.claim: Ahmed Qureshi's LinkedIn profile lists him as President/COO of Built Incorporated, an O6 commanding officer (Navy Captain) at East Coast HQ since May 2024.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current rank and command assignment via official military biography.

claims.label: Ahmed Qureshi and Nathan Henderson Co-Founded Built Incorporated
claims.claim: Built Incorporated was co-founded by Ahmed Qureshi (an O5 at the time) and Nathan Henderson in 2015.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check corporate registration records (Secretary of State filings in Texas) for Built Incorporated founders and incorporation date.

claims.label: Built Inc. Received ~$7.4M Air Force + ~$240K Navy in June 2025
claims.claim: USA Spending records show Built Incorporated received approximately $7.4M from the Air Force and just under $240K from the Navy in June 2025, with the largest contracts dated June 1 and June 16, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the raw USA Spending entries for Built Inc. by UEI, confirm contract amounts and dates against Baron Coleman's timeline.

claims.label: Gina Romney Henderson Is VP UX at Built Inc. and BYU Alumna
claims.claim: Gina Romney Henderson's LinkedIn profile identifies her as Vice President of User Experience at Built Incorporated and as a BYU alumna.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm employment and BYU degree via LinkedIn and university alumni records; investigate "Romney" family-tie claim.

claims.label: Connor Henderson Worked as ER Scribe at Timpanogos
claims.claim: Connor Henderson worked as an emergency room scribe at Timpanogos Hospital from 2024 until approximately the time of Charlie Kirk's assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Connor Henderson's actual LinkedIn profile; verify Timpanogos HR records of scribe employment.

claims.label: FBI Abandoned Comparative Bullet Lead Analysis in 2005
claims.claim: Per a 2007 Washington Post article, the FBI formally abandoned comparative bullet lead analysis in 2005 after a 2004 National Academy of Sciences report found the technique unreliable.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the 2004 NAS report and 2007 WaPo article in full; verify FBI's formal abandonment date.

claims.label: FBI Is Reviving CBLA in Robinson Case
claims.claim: The FBI is bringing the previously abandoned comparative bullet lead analysis technique back into use in an effort to connect Tyler Robinson's weapon to the alleged crime scene bullet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court filings and ATF lab reports in the Robinson case to confirm whether CBLA is being used or referenced.

claims.label: Trump Told Erika Kirk at Easter to Sue Critics
claims.claim: At a 2026 White House Easter event, Donald Trump told Erika Kirk that she should sue people mocking her because they are jealous of her.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full unedited video of the Easter remarks; document any subsequent legal actions filed by Kirk.

claims.label: Qureshi and Henderson Families Lived in Same House, Keller, Texas
claims.claim: The Qureshi and Henderson families lived in the same house in Keller, Texas; the host offers alternative explanations (vacation rental, sale) but asserts cohabitation is not in dispute.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull property records for Keller, Texas to identify ownership/residency history of both families.

claims.label: Andrew Zenger Appointed CEO of Timpanogos on 2025-08-19
claims.claim: Andrew Zenger was appointed CEO of Timpanogos Hospital on August 19, 2025, weeks before the September 10 event.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via Timpanogos press releases, LinkedIn, or Utah business filings.

claims.label: Andrew Zenger Previously COO at Medical City, McKinney, Texas
claims.claim: Prior to Timpanogos, Andrew Zenger served as COO of Medical City in McKinney, Texas.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Medical City Healthcare press releases or LinkedIn employment history.

claims.label: Andrew Zenger Attended BYU Jerusalem
claims.claim: Andrew Zenger attended BYU Jerusalem, with the host noting he was there during the 2012 Romney presidential campaign season.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via BYU Jerusalem Center enrollment records or alumni directory.

claims.label: BYU Jerusalem Is a CIA Recruitment Site for Elite Mormon Youth
claims.claim: Per a single unnamed source, the BYU Jerusalem Center is used by the CIA to recruit elite Mormon youth, with the program director being Israeli.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corroborating documentation; on-screen artifact required to elevate from claim to inscribed record.

claims.label: Metro One Talent Is the CIA's Recruiting Vendor
claims.claim: The CIA uses a company called Metro One Talent to interview and onboard BYU Jerusalem recruits.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify Metro One Talent corporate records and any government contract listings.

claims.label: Michael Shawn Covey (Zenger's Jerusalem Roommate) Does CIA Contract Work
claims.claim: Michael Shawn Covey, a roommate of Andrew Zenger from the Jerusalem period, contracts with the CIA.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any government contract records for "Michael Shawn Covey."

claims.label: Robbie Hild Attended BYU, Played Lacrosse, Graduated ~2020
claims.claim: Robbie Hild attended BYU, played lacrosse, and appears to have graduated around 2020.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via BYU athletics records and class roster.

claims.label: Turning Point Sent Fundraising Texts Within 48 Hours of Death
claims.claim: Turning Point USA sent text-message fundraising solicitations from "Erika" within approximately 48 hours of Charlie Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain copies of the original SMS messages and the timestamp metadata.

claims.label: Turning Point Sent Funeral-Image Direct Mail Fundraising
claims.claim: Turning Point sent a direct mail piece featuring an image of Erika Kirk walking out at Charlie's funeral in a sparkle suit with fireworks, used as a fundraising solicitation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the actual mailer from recipients; verify whether the image is from the funeral or another event.

claims.label: Robbie Hild Family Allegedly Married Into Romney Family
claims.claim: Viewers and social media indicate the Hild family is married into the Romney family, but the host cannot relocate the underlying document establishing this connection and requests viewer tips.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via marriage records, family genealogical databases, or corroborating viewer emails with documentation.

claims.label: Caleb Cunningham Was in Jerusalem During 2012 Romney Campaign
claims.claim: Caleb Cunningham was in Jerusalem with Andrew Zenger during the Romney 2012 presidential campaign and was active on the campaign.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Romney 2012 campaign staff lists and BYU Jerusalem Center enrollment.

claims.label: Jeffrey Knuckles Was in Jerusalem and Later Romney Campaign Advisor
claims.claim: Jeffrey Knuckles was in Jerusalem with Andrew Zenger during the 2012 Romney campaign period and later served as an advisor to Romney's campaign.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Romney 2012 campaign staff biographies.

claims.label: BYU Recruits CIA Talent From Hawaii and Jerusalem Campuses
claims.claim: BYU is said to recruit CIA talent from its Hawaii and Jerusalem campuses specifically.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify any open-source reporting on BYU recruitment ties.

claims.label: Dr. Steven Jones (BYU Physicist) Published 2009 Thermite Study on WTC Dust
claims.claim: BYU physicist Dr. Steven Jones published a 2009 study demonstrating advanced thermite-based explosives in WTC dust.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the actual 2009 paper and verify the journal of publication and peer review status.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson Defense Should Demand 600,000 Documents
claims.claim: Viewer Kael Miles suggests the Robinson defense should make ~600,000 documents public for review; host concurs and offers to serve as unpaid document-review army.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the document set being referenced and any pending defense motions for discovery.
